guidance.summary: Potential hard-coded credential; review data flow and deployment context before treating it as exploitable.
guidance.impact: Hard-coded credential can affect confidentiality, integrity or availability when reachable from an untrusted input or insecure configuration.
guidance.concept: CWE-798; A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures. A pattern match requires validation of data flow and deployment context.
guidance.safer_pattern: Remove the credential, rotate it if real, and load it from a secret manager or environment.
guidance.proposed_change: Review app.py:6. Remove the credential, rotate it if real, and load it from a secret manager or environment. Add a regression test for the original unsafe behavior. No patch has been applied.
guidance.false_positive: Check whether input is trusted, whether this is a test fixture, whether the dependency is actually deployed, and whether the flagged code is reachable. Record evidence before suppressing.
